# pcd_networking_router_route (Resource)

Manages a single static route on a Neutron router without disturbing routes managed elsewhere. Every attribute forces a new resource. Multiple router_route resources on the same router are applied serially so they do not clobber each other's routes.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pcd_networking_router" "example" {
  name = "tf-example-router"
}

resource "pcd_networking_router_route" "example" {
  router_id        = pcd_networking_router.example.id
  destination_cidr = "10.20.0.0/24"
  next_hop         = "10.0.0.1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `destination_cidr` (String) The destination CIDR. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `next_hop` (String) The next-hop IP address. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `router_id` (String) The router to add the route to. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `region` (String) The region. Defaults to the provider's region.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite ID: `router_id/destination_cidr/next_hop`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import pcd_networking_router_route.example <router_id>/<destination_cidr>/<next_hop>
```
